summary: A Wired midweek roundup by Eric Ravenscraft (October 19, 2023) of 14 deals on TVs, soundbars, keyboards, gaming mice, chargers and earbuds, published as Black Friday approaches. It highlights WIRED Recommends picks such as the Samsung S95C, LG C3, NZXT Function, SteelSeries Prime Wireless, Google Pixel Buds A-Series and Samsung Galaxy Buds. It also notes Anker's early Black Friday sale and advises waiting on some items, like the Pixel Buds, which dip lower during major sale events.
one_line: Wired's October 19, 2023 roundup of 14 tech deals on TVs, keyboards, gaming mice, Anker chargers and earbuds ahead of Black Friday.
key_facts: The Samsung S95C (8/10, WIRED Recommends) is a favorite TV thanks to its quantum dot OLED panel, perfect black levels and bright image, and it has a centered pedestal mount.
The LG C3 is Wired's top TV pick for gamers, with a 120-Hz refresh rate and 9.2 millisecond response time.
A Polk soundbar with a subwoofer and several audio presets is recommended as an upgrade over built-in TV speakers.
The NZXT Function (8/10, WIRED Recommends) is a good starting mechanical keyboard, letting buyers configure switches and keycaps at purchase.
The Roccat Vulcan 121 is recommended for fans of very loud clicky switches, with semi-clear switches illuminated from below.

The Logitech G915 is the author's personal favorite keyboard, thanks to Logitech's G Hub software for automating tasks, and it suits creative tools like DaVinci Resolve, Premiere, Blender and Cinema 4D.
The Roccat Vulcan II Mini has two LEDs per switch, twice as many as usual, enabling smoother color animations and indicating when mute is enabled.
The SteelSeries Prime Wireless Mouse is Wired's top overall gaming mouse pick, designed with esports professionals in mind, with solid wireless connectivity even around 10 feet from the receiver.

Anker is kicking off its Black Friday sale early with discounts and a buy-one-get-another-50-percent-off promotion; standouts include the Anker Prime power bank, Anker Nano Power Bank and the tiny 511 30-watt charger.

The Google Pixel Buds A-Series (8/10, WIRED Recommends) are the top overall earbuds pick, with up to five hours of battery life plus 19 more via the case, and IPX4 water resistance; they dip to $59 during major sales.
The Samsung Galaxy Buds2 Pro (9/10, WIRED Recommends) have excellent sound, a comfortable fit and IPX7 water resistance, but lack multi-device connectivity.
The Galaxy Buds2 (9/10, WIRED Recommends) get five hours of battery life with active noise canceling on and 7.5 hours with it off; the deal applies only to the olive green model.
Wired offers Gear readers a subscription for $5 ($25 off).
